candidates.name: env_interaction_guidance
candidates.hypothesis: Supplying general interactive household environment domain principles in context_mgmt (standard action formats, conditioning objects directly in inventory without placing them inside appliances first, and recognizing that co-located fixtures share positions so 'Nothing happens' on navigation means direct interaction is available) will eliminate appliance-misuse recovery loops and redundant admissible_commands exploratory calls, reducing mean turns by ~15-20% and preventing step budget exhaustion on complex multi-stage tasks while maintaining 100% pass rate.
candidates.changes: In variants/context_mgmt/default.py, set default extra_system guidance detailing standard action primitives, inventory-based object conditioning (heat/cool/clean), and co-located fixture mechanics.
candidates.expected_efficiency: Maintains 100% pass rate while reducing mean turns from 10.4 to ~8.5-9.0 and reducing total token consumption by ~15%.
